about: This Elf template shows Will Ferrell as Buddy in Elf (2003), in his green elf suit with the yellow-banded hat, staring straight ahead with a furious, betrayed frown in front of a paper-chain Christmas display. Buddy grew up believing completely in Santa, so when he realizes the department-store Santa is a fake, he confronts him with the most dramatic accusation he can think of. The meme uses that line to call out any lie, fake claim or misleading promise, usually something small that Buddy-style outrage makes ridiculous.
origin: The quote comes from Elf (2003), directed by Jon Favreau, when Buddy unmasks the mall Santa at the store where he works and declares he sits on a throne of lies.
usage:
The top box quotes or describes the lie: a product claim, a promise, an excuse. It can also be left blank. The bottom box is the verdict: the throne-of-lies line itself, or a variation like "you smell like beef and cheese" for fans of the scene.

It is funniest when the lie is minor but annoying: "5 minutes away", "one size fits all", "no spoilers", game loading screens that say "almost done". Buddy's sincere fury makes petty dishonesty feel like a major scandal.
